summary.zh: 了解某话题近期在社区和网络上的讨论与情绪
summary.en: See what people are saying about a topic right now

description.zh: 围绕一个话题，收集近期在 Reddit、Hacker News 和网页上的讨论，整理成带引用出处的简要报告，并标出互动热度。适合新品调研、竞品对比或发布前快速摸清真实反馈。需要联网访问这些公开来源。
description.en: Collects recent discussion about a topic across Reddit, Hacker News and the web, then returns a cited briefing with engagement signals. Useful before product research, competitor comparisons or sentiment checks. Requires internet access.
